#### Checkpoint-first execution and durable controller evidence — 2026-11-24

Rohan's direct deadline now prioritizes a usable checkpoint before finishing the
general learning-controller research. Unknown remains unknown, and the existing
source, independent semantic, full replay, runtime and declared-workload gates
remain binding. Sparse activation and whole-lexicon completion remain distinct.

The controller's new owned-scope verification passes **1,800 tests with zero
skips, failures or errors**, including the actual Regenesis guard imputer. The
writer accepts bounded explicit entry–bank tuples on its existing sustained,
validated connection without asking the Cartesian product of those entries and
banks. A durable head transition installs an epoch and its content-addressed
outcome atomically. Resume no longer needs every historical phase database;
owned-stage retirement preserves complete native streams and every unique audit
delta before unlinking. Connected synthetic tests interrupt teaching-result,
migration-result, pre/post head CAS and post-unlink boundaries, actually remove
old databases, and retain the accepted questions without repeating them. Explicit
reviewed joint revisions use ordinary migration; unsupported conclusions reopen
while independent support survives. A rule warrant cannot silently review an
earlier model-answer prefix. These are software-mechanism results, not new
English bank laws or corpus contractions. Publication-interruption recovery and
the complete generic surprise/joint-tuple language remain open.

The real reference-scope census finds **25,263 definitions**, with **six active
model receipts across four definitions**. Their full chains must be retained and
reconsidered under migration rather than quietly treated as independent native
proofs. The eight prepared teaching/audit questions preserve exact wire fields,
schema and transport. Replaying the original water/I reply through typed
admission **in memory** yields ASSIGNED; stale-context and wrong-bank adversarial
probes yield STALE_REQUEST and INVALID_OUTPUT, and null preserves the open bank.
For that single definition the exact in-memory joint contraction is
**1.2801079191927442 bits**, while its marginal-domain reduction is
**1.5849625007211614 bits**. This difference is another concrete reason not to
substitute marginal arithmetic for joint specification space. This probe writes
no lexical cell and is not a measured corpus teaching phase.

The original v1 evidence is unchanged. A separate explicit v2 curriculum/rebase
preserves the unpublished foundation lineage and the original reusable water/I
request. The root subsequently completed seven fresh reference questions with
the original pinned model/protocol; dog/I was NULL and remains an explicit
reservation. The controller consumes retained journals rather than repeating
them. The original 50,526-cell population forecast was not a committed result;
the measured private phases and later joint stage are separated below. No new
exponential-learning claim follows from these preparations.

A source-driven next frontier tests native event ancestry against its exact
defining genus. It contains 9,420 attested native noun definitions: 167 already
carry HAPPEN=+1 and 9,253 remain open. The exact `passing.n.02` definition under
“going” reads “euphemistic expressions for death” despite its event/death
ancestry. This is retained as a source/role scope challenge, not assigned an
opposing zero or hidden from the denominator. The broad candidate remains
pending boundary review and fresh independent audits. Legacy taxonomy proposal
labels and aggregate spelling frequency do not authorize it. Runtime benchmark
labels inspected for gate integration remain outside construction warrants and
requests; they cannot be reused as untouched confirmations if they guide a
subsequent repair.

`ssl-api-controller-owned-tests.xml`, `ssl-api-controller-model-prefix-census.json`,

under the existing `docs/readings/2026-11-13-ssl-explicit-genera/` directory. The
controller edit boundary is not a whole-run freeze; that awaits the runtime
worker's repaired completion receipt and the integrated repository gate. The
active pointer remains sparse release 021 at this recording.
